pronunciation: ha-JOO (ha as in 'hah', joo rhymes with 'zoo')

example.romanization: Ngài hâ-chu oi hi sṳ-chhòng mâi-chhoi.
example.english: I'm going to the market this afternoon to buy vegetables.

note: 下畫 literally means 'below the daytime', splitting the day the way Hakka traditionally does around the midday meal rather than the 12-hour clock; some speakers also say 下晝 with the same pronunciation.
